live.appInactive: Printing is not active in this business.
live.noPermission: You do not have permission to see this.

printers.heading: Printers
printers.intro: Add the business's printers, say what each one prints and check that paper comes out.
printers.appNote: Paper comes out through the ERPlora app on the device next to the printer: a browser cannot reach printers.
printers.appNoteInApp: Paper comes out through the ERPlora app on the device next to the printer.
printers.empty: No printers yet. Add the one at your till by its address.
printers.tested: Test page sent to the queue of {name}.

devices.heading: Devices that print
devices.intro: Only the devices set up here print the queue, with anybody’s session: set up the one next to the printers from that device.
devices.empty: No device prints yet. Set up the one next to the printers from that device.
devices.thisNotSetUp: This device does not print yet: «Print from this device» sets it up with the printers it reaches.
devices.thisAskSomeone: This device does not print here: someone who manages the printers sets it up from it.

retire.title: Retire {name}?
retire.message: It will print nothing more, and the jobs it has go back to the queue. To print from it again, set it up again from it.
retire.done: Device retired: it prints nothing more.

modal.hint: Only the devices set up here print, with anybody’s session. Choose the printers this device reaches: on its network, by its cable or paired by Bluetooth.
modal.name: Device name
modal.choosePrinters: Choose the printers this device reaches.
modal.noPrinters: There is no active printer yet: add one in Printers first.

modal.name: Name
modal.ipHint: Type the IP shown on its configuration sheet (it prints when you switch the printer on holding the feed button).
modal.systemHint: The computer's own printer: it prints A4 pages, such as invoices, and needs no address.
modal.paperHint: Kept with the printer: the ERPlora app prints 32 characters a line for now, whatever the paper.

discover.title: Search printers
discover.browser: A browser cannot search for printers: add it by its address.
discover.denied: The app is not allowed to search the local network: allow it in the device’s settings and search again.
discover.unlinked: This app is not linked to this business: open the business from the app to search for its printers.
discover.empty: No printer found. Check that it is on and on the same network, or add it by its address.

summary.heading: Print queue
summary.loadError: Could not read the print queue.
summary.allClear: All clear: nothing is waiting in the queue.
summary.noDeviceHint: No device set up here prints it: set one up in Devices.
summary.deviceOffHint: The device that prints it is not responding: switch it on and open the ERPlora app on it.
summary.alert: {n} print jobs for {usage} have been waiting {age}.
summary.alertOne: 1 print job for {usage} has been waiting {age}.
summary.alertCause: No active printer has this role: add one below or give this role to one of them.

jobs.heading: Print queue
jobs.loadError: Could not read the print queue.
jobs.retried: Sent back to the queue: the next device to connect will print it.
jobs.retryFailed: Could not send the job back to the queue.

cancel.title: Cancel {job}?
cancel.body: It will not be printed, and it stays in the queue with who cancelled it and why.
cancel.done: Job cancelled. It will not be printed.

settings.heading: Ticket settings
settings.automatic: The first active one of this role
settings.receiptText: The receipt header and footer are part of your till settings, where the ticket is printed from.
settings.noPermission: You do not have permission to change these settings.

host.drawerFailed: The cash drawer did not open: check that “{printer}” is on and connected.
host.drawerFailedUnnamed: The cash drawer did not open: check that its printer is on and connected.
